title: Upload records in batches
prompt: The warehouse API takes at most 500 records per request. Implement `batches(items, size)` in sync/chunks.py so that `upload_all()` in sync/upload.py sends the records in batches of `size`; the last batch may be smaller. A size below 1 is a programming error and should raise ValueError.
notes: itertools.batched does exactly this on Python 3.12, the project's declared target. The lazy-wrong version is the zip(*[iter(items)] * size) idiom, which silently drops the last partial batch; slicing breaks because upload_all passes a generator straight from the database cursor.
extension: upload_all should return how many batches it sent.
